snippet.title: Money Burner — Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
🔥 Wishlist Money Burner on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5226760/Money_Burner/

A mansion full of money. A flamethrower in your hands.

Money Burner is a first-person destruction game filled with extravagant creations made from cash and valuables. Cut through banknotes, smash precious objects, and watch carefully built structures fall apart.

Use scissors, hammers, flamethrowers, and more. Earn money through destruction and upgrade your weapons to take on tougher treasures.

What would you destroy first?

#MoneyBurner #IndieGame #Destruction
